entries.title: Job 41:1
segments: Canst thou draw out leviathan with a fishhook? Or press down his tongue with a cord?

entries.title: Job 41:2
segments: Canst thou put a rope into his nose? Or pierce his jaw through with a hook?

entries.title: Job 41:3
segments: Will he make many supplications unto thee? Or will he speak soft words unto thee?

entries.title: Job 41:4
segments: Will he make a covenant with thee, That thou shouldest take him for a servant for ever?

entries.title: Job 41:5
segments: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? Or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?

entries.title: Job 41:6
segments: Will the bands [of fishermen] make traffic of him? Will they part him among the merchants?

entries.title: Job 41:7
segments: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons, Or his head with fish-spears?

entries.title: Job 41:8
segments: Lay thy hand upon him; Remember the battle, and do so no more.

entries.title: Job 41:9
segments: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: Will not one be cast down even at the sight of him?

entries.title: Job 41:10
segments: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up; Who then is he that can stand before me?

entries.title: Job 41:11
segments: Who hath first given unto me, that I should repay him? [Whatsoever is] under the whole heaven is mine.

entries.title: Job 41:12
segments: I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, Nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.

entries.title: Job 41:13
segments: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who shall come within his jaws?

entries.title: Job 41:14
segments: Who can open the doors of his face? Round about his teeth is terror.

entries.title: Job 41:15
segments: [His] strong scales are [his] pride, Shut up together [as with] a close seal.

entries.title: Job 41:16
segments: One is so near to another, That no air can come between them.

entries.title: Job 41:17
segments: They are joined one to another; They stick together, so that they cannot be sundered.

entries.title: Job 41:18
segments: His sneezings flash forth light, And his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

entries.title: Job 41:19
segments: Out of his mouth go burning torches, And sparks of fire leap forth.

entries.title: Job 41:20
segments: Out of his nostrils a smoke goeth, As of a boiling pot and [burning] rushes.

entries.title: Job 41:21
segments: His breath kindleth coals, And a flame goeth forth from his mouth.

entries.title: Job 41:22
segments: In his neck abideth strength, And terror danceth before him.

entries.title: Job 41:23
segments: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: They are firm upon him; they cannot be moved.

entries.title: Job 41:24
segments: His heart is as firm as a stone; Yea, firm as the nether millstone.

entries.title: Job 41:25
segments: When he raiseth himself up, the mighty are afraid: By reason of consternation they are beside themselves.

entries.title: Job 41:26
segments: If one lay at him with the sword, it cannot avail; Nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

entries.title: Job 41:27
segments: He counteth iron as straw, [And] brass as rotten wood.

entries.title: Job 41:28
segments: The arrow cannot make him flee: Sling-stones are turned with him into stubble.

entries.title: Job 41:29
segments: Clubs are counted as stubble: He laugheth at the rushing of the javelin.

entries.title: Job 41:30
segments: His underparts are [like] sharp potsherds: He spreadeth [as it were] a threshing-wain upon the mire.

entries.title: Job 41:31
segments: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: He maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.

entries.title: Job 41:32
segments: He maketh a path to shine after him; One would think the deep to be hoary.

entries.title: Job 41:33
segments: Upon earth there is not his like, That is made without fear.

entries.title: Job 41:34
segments: He beholdeth everything that is high: He is king over all the sons of pride.
